name: ParseSignedDecimal
evidence: reads an optional '-' and decimal digits from the string, stores the value and returns the number of characters used; func_001E0978 uses it for width and precision

name: ParseFormatSpec
evidence: state machine over a '%' conversion: flags '-', '+', ' ', '#', '0', width and precision (or '*' from the argument list), length letters, then the conversion character, filling the 0x34-byte spec and returning the characters consumed

name: FormatStringArg
evidence: writes a string argument ("(null)" if 0) to the output buffer, cut to the precision and padded to the width with spaces (or zeros) on the left or right

name: ExtractIntegerSign
evidence: widens an unsigned short argument for length 1, and for %d / %i makes a negative value positive in place (by its length 0, 1 or 2), returning whether it was negative

name: GetConversionRadix
evidence: returns 10 for d, i and u, 2 for b, 8 for o and 16 for x

name: WriteIntegerDigits
evidence: writes value in the given radix into the buffer from the digit table D_00275940 (most significant first) and returns the digit count

name: FormatIntegerArg
evidence: builds the sign or 0b / 0 / 0x prefix, the digits and the zero padding for an integer conversion and writes them with the width padding to the output buffer

name: GetDecimalExponent
evidence: returns floor of the base-10 logarithm of a positive double (0 for non-positive values)

name: GetDecimalDigit
evidence: returns the digit character of the double at decimal position index, or '0' outside 15 digits of the leading one

name: FormatFloatDigits
evidence: writes the digits of a double for e, f and g conversions (rounding, decimal point, trailing-zero trimming for g, e+NNN exponent) into the buffer, or "(nan)" / "(inf)"

name: FormatFloatArg
evidence: defaults the precision to 6, takes the sign, formats the digits with FormatFloatDigits and writes sign, padding and digits to the output buffer

name: FormatConversionArg
evidence: switch on the conversion character: % and c write one byte, s calls FormatStringArg, p / b / d / i / o / u / x take an integer argument and call FormatIntegerArg, e / f / g call FormatFloatArg, n stores the output count

name: FormatToOutputBuffer
evidence: copies the text between '%' signs to the output buffer, parses each conversion with ParseFormatSpec and writes it with FormatConversionArg, flushes and returns the count

name: PrintFormattedVa
evidence: formats through an output buffer with no memory target (capacity -1) that FlushOutputBuffer sends to the console write, returning the count

name: PrintFormatted
evidence: the variadic entry of PrintFormattedVa: builds the argument pointer from its own frame

name: FormatToStringVa
evidence: formats into dst through an output buffer, NUL-terminates it and returns the length

name: FormatToString
evidence: the variadic entry of FormatToStringVa

name: FormatToStringBoundedVa
evidence: formats into dst limited to cap bytes; returns -1 and terminates at cap - 1 when it did not fit

name: FormatToStringBounded
evidence: the variadic entry of FormatToStringBoundedVa

name: GetStringLength
evidence: counts bytes up to the NUL

name: CopyString
evidence: copies the string and its NUL with func_0018D800 and returns dst

name: AppendString
evidence: copies src after the end of dst and returns dst

name: FindCharInString

name: UppercaseString
evidence: subtracts 0x20 from each character whose class bit 2 is set in D_0024E879 (lower-case letters)

name: CreateLockSemaphore
evidence: zeroes a 0x18-byte record, stores its two arguments and hands it to func_001F6B20 (a kernel create call), returning the id

name: InitRecursiveLock
evidence: sets last to -1 and the semaphore to CreateLockSemaphore(1, 1); the callers pass D_002C2A28

name: EnterRecursiveLock
evidence: takes the current thread id (func_001F6A90); when it differs from last it waits on the semaphore (func_001F6B60) and sets count to 1, otherwise adds 1 to count

name: LeaveRecursiveLock
evidence: subtracts 1 from count and, at 0, clears last to -1 and signals the semaphore with func_001F6B40

name: CreateRenderThread
evidence: fills a thread init record (entry RunRenderThread, 0x20000-byte stack D_006056D0, priority 2, global pointer) and creates the thread into g_mainAndRenderThreads

name: GetOnOffObjectBlock

name: StartOnOffObject

name: SetOnOffObjectState

name: SetOnOffObjectForcedState

name: UpdateOnOffObjectState
evidence: takes the object func_001925F0 returns and, when f398 is -1, sets the state from whether func_001E4DC0 is positive for its position in this object's frame, otherwise from f398, then calls SetOnOffObjectState

name: RunPendingWorldLoad
